assumptions_and_limits: Pointwise one-sided confidence endpoints, not simultaneous intervals or selection-corrected performance guarantees across cohorts, rates, receiver choices, strict/relaxed gates or adaptive development.

Within-bit independent identically distributed Bernoulli outcomes from the declared simulation population are required for per-bit CP; globally distinct seed roots support recorded independence design but do not prove PRNG independence or field validity.

Balanced-mean lower bounds allow different bit-stratum success probabilities. All-success equal-stratum cases use AM-GM; partial-success cases use Bonferroni per-bit bounds. Pooled CP assumes a common success probability and is labeled separately.
Fixed aligned/tightly bounded acquisition model and selected channel/oscillator/noise settings only; this is not generic all-purpose blind-acquisition or RF hardware qualification.
Conditional noise replicas, paired receiver/compression variants and administrative reruns are not additional independent primary physical paths.

No empirical daily false-admission qualification is established by the signal matrix or sparse null controls. Analytical gate guarantees require the detector/calibration and declared candidate/attempt/model/duration families assumptions.
G1 jobs explicitly select one calibration alternative, other primary jobs select two; do not silently combine their policies into an unallocated common selectable family.
This receipt binds reviewed artifacts by hashes after execution; it is not proof of a prior timestamped source/binary hash commitment.
Archive inventory binding and remote-to-local archive integrity remain root-owned final packaging checks.
